mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_vectors WHERE document_id = #{DocumentId} AND user_id = #{userId} RETURNING id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO knowledge_vectors ( knowledge_id, document_id, user_id, embedding, content, metadata, chunk_index, chunk_hash, token_count ) VALUES
( #{r.knowledgeId}, #{r.documentId}, #{r.userId}, CAST(#{r.embedding} AS vector), #{r.content}, #{r.metadata, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}, #{r.chunkIndex}, #{r.chunkHash}, #{r.tokenCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT kv.id, kv.document_id AS documentId, kv.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, kv.content, kv.metadata, (1 - (kv.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryEmbedding} AS vector))) AS score FROM knowledge_vectors kv WHERE kv.user_id = #{userId} AND kv.knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} ORDER BY kv.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryEmbedding} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}
